description.text: Shenyang Aerospace University (SAU) is founded in 1952 and located in Shenyang. During the past 70 years, Shenyang Aerospace University has developed into an academic center, housing teaching buildings, research laboratories, a library which is both an architectural and cultural icon, a theater building, sports arena, swimming center and student’s activity centers having 600,000 square meters of floor space and cover 200,000 square meters of landscaped gardens. Other services such as the school hospital, comfortable accommodations and a number of dining halls are also provided.Established in the School of Transportation Science and Engineering, this major mainly focuses on intelligent operation in the air transportation industry and intelligent maintenance design theory and technology in the aviation manufacturing industry.

duration.text: The Aircraft Maintenance at Shenyang Aerospace University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

requirements.text: Applicants shall be younger than 25 years old. 2. Applicants shall achieve a high school diploma or equivalent
